scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config --local core.hooksPath hooks || true
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @withmarfa/server run generate:openapi && pnpm --filter @withmarfa/client run generate && pnpm run generate:rust && pnpm run generate:swift
scripts.generate:rust: cd core/marfa-client && openapi-generator-cli generate --generator-key marfa-client && cargo fmt -p marfa-client
scripts.generate:swift: swift build -c release --package-path swift/generator --product swift-openapi-generator && swift/generator/.build/release/swift-openapi-generator generate --config swift/openapi-generator-config.yaml --output-directory swift/Sources/MarfaTypes openapi.json && tsx swift/generate-contract.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p ci --noEmit && tsc -p swift --noEmit
scripts.test:full: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:offline-lane && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:fresh-sqlite
scripts.test:rust: cd core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cd bindings/swift && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
